description: Configuration for RS (Relative Strength) Strategies - Controls both RS_ETF and RS_Stocks

stop_loss_settings.description: If true, stop loss is checked daily. If false, stop loss is checked only on signal generation day (Friday/last trading day of week)
stop_loss_settings.note: Daily check provides better risk protection but may increase trading frequency. Weekly check aligns with the strategy's weekly rebalancing philosophy.

stop_loss_execution.daily: Execute stop loss exits immediately when triggered
stop_loss_execution.weekly: Accumulate stop loss exits and execute on Monday with other signals
